title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals
description:
You are given an array nums.

For every possible subset of nums:

Compute the XOR of its elements
Add all these XOR values together

Return the final sum.

Important Points
A subset can be:
Empty → XOR = 0
Any combination of elements
Total subsets = 2^n
Even duplicate-value subsets (from different positions) count separately
Examples

Example 1

nums = [1,3]
→ 6

Example 2

nums = [5,1,6]
→ 28

Example 3

nums = [3,4,5,6,7,8]
→ 480
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
